q: Can you explain step 8 a little bit in more details? So what is the smooth scaling law and what does it mean?
reply: **Done (2026-10-16).** Step 8 is rewritten as a ladder: what was measured (the loss on held-out text), the formula read aloud, and what *power law* and *smooth* mean (the same ~5% drop per doubling at every size, a straight line on log–log axes).
